build_coefficient_mapping: build a CoefficientMapping module to map spherical harmonic coefficients between degree l and order m indices
create_so3_grid: create an SO3_Grid module to transform irreps to and from 3D grid representations using spherical harmonics
test_coefficient_idx: test the CoefficientMapping coefficient_idx method to retrieve indices for a given degree l and order m
refactor_complex_idx: refactor the CoefficientMapping complex_idx method to filter real and imaginary coefficient indices by order m
summarize_to_grid_from_grid: summarize the SO3_Grid to_grid and from_grid methods that convert between embedding irreps and grid tensors
